name: Outdoor Interiors
old_description: Explore fresh horizons with us as we introduce you to some groundbreaking innovations. Your journey to a more stylish and comfortable year begins here!
about:
Outdoor Interiors was founded in 2006 by Tim Cimaglio in Lake Barrington, Illinois. The company began with the goal of creating a distinctive product line in the outdoor living space, targeting an underserved niche with quality furniture at mid-tier price points.

The company designs and manufactures outdoor furniture using a blend of materials including FSC-certified teak, plantation-grown eucalyptus, powder-coated aluminum, HDPE all-weather wicker, nautical rope, sling fabrics, concrete composite, and natural stone. Operations span over 70,000 square feet of warehouse space and a 5,000-square-foot showroom at Atlanta's AmericasMart, with an additional showroom in Lake Barrington available by appointment. The product range covers folding loungers, stacking chairs, table sets, daybeds, and throw pillows across collections such as Bronson, Magnolia, Kimberly Ann Designs, and Antique Wash Eucalyptus.

Outdoor Interiors sells through a network of more than 150 dealers across North America and key retail groups. The dealer-focused model serves residential customers seeking patio and garden furnishings, while the showrooms support both dealer and designer specification.

The brand differentiates itself through sustainable sourcing of plantation-grown hardwoods, integrated storage solutions in fully assembled pieces, and a mixed-material aesthetic that combines wood, metal, wicker, rope, concrete, and stone at accessible price points.
